facts.fact: Micah 记录 Maple 第 10 天：58.5 磅、食欲佳、活动量高。
回想 Alder Ridge 狮鹫聚落畸翅案例：违禁炼金农药沿食物链致畸。
facts.anchor: Nearly every chick hatched over a three-year span had malformed wings.

facts.fact: Maple 不符群体中毒模式，成因未明。
facts.anchor: But Maple doesn’t fit that pattern. She seems to be the only dragon with the condition.

facts.fact: Lucan 携完成的第一副义翅到后院。
facts.anchor: When he lifts out the prototype, my breath catches.

facts.fact: 用培根引开注意，逐条调节挽具。
facts.anchor: While she busies herself chewing, Lucan threads the padded leather harness beneath her forelimbs and around her chest

facts.fact: Maple 短暂离地，随即摔倒、翻滚挣脱。
facts.anchor: For one glorious heartbeat, all four of her feet leave the ground.

facts.fact: 喷火烧毁皮革，焦黑扣件变形。
facts.anchor: A stream of bright orange fire engulfs the leather.

facts.fact: 两人确认概念可行；Micah 邀 Lucan 进屋喝茶。
facts.anchor: “Now I just need to make it better.”
